source_title: JEREMIAH'S ITALIAN ICE UNVEILS HOLIDAY FLAVORITES LINEUP FEATURING DEBUT OF HOT CHOCOLATE ITALIAN ICE
source_excerpt:
Frozen Hot Chocolate, Peppermint Bark and Candy Cane-inspired treats bring festive flavors to the frozen dessert menu this holiday season
ORLANDO, Fla. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jeremiah's Italian Ice is bringing festive flavor to the holiday season with its limited-time Holiday Flavorites Collection. Available November 1 through December 31 , the lineup features the debut of new Hot Chocolate Ice and a variety of seasonal treats inspired by holiday favorites like peppermint bark, candy canes and hot cocoa.
Available at participating locations nationwide, the seasonal menu combines rich cocoa flavors, Mini Marshmallows and Crushed Peppermint Candies to create a collection of holiday-inspired frozen treats perfect for celebrating the most wonderful time of the year.
The Holiday Flavorites Collection includes:
Frozen Hot Chocolate Flavorite â Hot Chocolate Ice layered with Vanilla Soft Ice Cream and Mini Marshmallows, delivering all the cozy flavors of hot cocoa in a refreshing frozen treat.
Peppermint Bark Flavorite â Hot Chocolate Ice layered with Vanilla Soft Ice Cream and Crushed Peppermint Candies, inspired by the beloved holiday confection and packed with cool peppermint crunch.
Candy Cane Hot Chocolate Flavorite â Hot Chocolate Ice layered with Vanilla Soft Ice Cream, Mini Marshmallows and Crushed Peppermint Candies for a festive twist on a seasonal favorite.
Peppermint Bark JelatiÂ® Cake â Sliceable layers of Hot Chocolate Ice and Vanilla Soft Ice Cream finished with Crushed Peppermint Candies, creating a shareable dessert made for holiday gatherings and celebrations.
Peppermint OreoÂ® Ice Cream Sandwich â A seasonal Ice Cream Sandwich featuring peppermint-flavored ice cream nestled between OreoÂ® cookies for a cool take on a holiday classic.
Inspired by the flavors and traditions that make the holidays memorable, the Holiday Flavorites lineup transforms seasonal favorites like hot cocoa, peppermint bark and candy canes into festive frozen treats with a uniquely Jeremiah's twist.
"The holidays are all about creating memorable experiences with family and friends, and food has always been a big part of that," said Michael Keller, CEO of Jeremiah's Italian Ice. "Our Holiday Flavorites give guests a fun, festive way to celebrate the season while enjoying the bold flavors and frozen treats that make Jeremiah's unique."
High-resolution images of the Holiday Flavorites Collection are available HERE .
The Holiday Flavorites Collection will be available at participating Jeremiah's Italian Ice locations from November 1 through December 31 , while supplies last.
For more information, visit Jeremiah's Italian Ice online and follow updates on Facebook , Instagram , Twitter and LinkedIn .
